subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for `toolProgress` and `commandText`, and should any Feishu streaming toggle become mutable through `gateway config.patch`?
rationale: The remaining work changes a channel config contract and possibly an agent-facing config mutation boundary, which repository policy treats as compatibility and product/security-sensitive rather than an automatic bug fix.

options.title: Add nested Feishu preview policy
options.body: Preserve existing boolean behavior, add a documented object-form Feishu streaming policy for hiding or sanitizing tool progress, and keep `config.patch` protected unless separately approved.

options.title: Keep Feishu boolean-only
options.body: Leave current Feishu streaming behavior and require users to disable streaming by manual config edit if progress lines are too noisy.

options.title: Only adjust status wording
options.body: Avoid a new config surface and change progress wording only, accepting that Feishu users still cannot keep streaming while hiding tool progress.

recommendation.title: Add nested Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Preserve existing boolean behavior, add a documented object-form Feishu streaming policy for hiding or sanitizing tool progress, and keep `config.patch` protected unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily in Feishu channel streaming behavior, and recent Feishu dispatcher history points to this contributor as the best available routing signal.
